description: Add photos to an existing product — from public URLs, or as base64 bytes when the merchant attached the file itself and there is no URL. URL images are downloaded and stored on the platform, so the product never depends on someone else's site staying up. Existing photos are KEPT — this adds to them. JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF/HEIC, up to 20MB each. Takes the product ID from get_products, never a name.

imageFiles.description: Photos the merchant attached — use when there is no public URL

imageUrls.description: Public URLs of the photos to add

productId.description: Product id from get_products — not a name

name: hub_add_product_images
title: Add product images
